title: Some Key Properties of Eigenfunctions Linked to Degenerate Elliptic Differential Operators
summary: In this study, we address the eigenvalue problem given by: \begin{equation*} \begin{cases} -\Div (w\nabla u_i)=\la_iu_i &\text{in } \Om\subset \mathbb{R}^n,\\ u_i=0 &\text{on } \pt \Om, \end{cases} \end{equation*} where $w > 0$ within $\Om$ and $w = 0$ on part of $\partial Ω$. We establish Courant's nodal domain theorem for the corresponding degenerate elliptic differential operator $\mathcal{A}$.
